name: Repair Light Damage (Rogue Genius Games)
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level sorcerer/wizard 1

DESCRIPTION

As cure light wounds, but it repairs objects and constructs that aren’t destroyed rather than healing living creatures.

The same rules can be used to create higher-level repair spells, based on higher-level cure spells.
